comment: Curated, pipeline-facing flow groups: one suite per test type, the way a QA team's catalogue reads (Asaf, 2026-11-20: 'sanity supposed to run all sanity, smoke should run all smoke, api all the api'). Each suite runs every test of its type; the runner shows them under their category's heading, and the k6 performance tests as one group. Hand-maintained: ids are stable and safe to reference from workflows, docs and bookmarks. They changed once, on 2026-11-20, when the suites were reorganized into one per type (group-sanity-all merged into group-sanity; group-contract became group-api, group-app group-e2e, group-scenarios group-agents, group-load-* group-perf-*). The label is the suite's name as people read it; the name is the short id-like word; the description is one line saying what runs and roughly what it costs. Spec-level and describe-level flows are discovered automatically by scripts/test-runner/discover-flows.js and do not belong here.

groups.name: smoke
groups.label: Smoke Test
groups.description: the bank canary: the new version is alive and its main path works; seconds

groups.name: sanity
groups.label: Sanity Test
groups.description: every sanity check of the site's pages; under a minute

groups.name: regression
groups.label: Regression Test
groups.description: every Playwright test; minutes, even across 8 machines

groups.name: functional
groups.label: Functional Test
groups.description: positive and negative paths: what should work, and bad input refused; seconds

groups.name: api
groups.label: API Test
groups.description: every API test of the bank, its contract against openapi.json included; no browser

groups.name: e2e
groups.label: End-to-End (E2E) Test
groups.description: every browser test of the bank's screens, as a customer and as staff

groups.name: seeded-defects
groups.label: Seeded Defect Test
groups.description: each planted fault fires only when it is switched on, and the site is correct when it is off

groups.name: visual
groups.label: Visual Regression Test
groups.description: screenshot comparison of /app/orders; needs baselines from the same platform

groups.name: unit
groups.label: Unit Test
groups.description: Vitest component and helper tests, no browser or app; seconds

groups.name: non-functional
groups.label: Non-Functional Test
groups.description: response-time budgets, the mobile layout and the broken-page detector; seconds

groups.name: infrastructure
groups.label: Infrastructure Test
groups.description: guards on the workflows, the version updater, the bots and the k6 set-up; no browser

groups.name: baseline
groups.label: Baseline Test
groups.description: k6, 5 users reading for 30 s on a fresh bank on the runner; about a minute

groups.name: load
groups.label: Load Test
groups.description: k6, up to 10 users reading, moving money and buying; about a minute and a half

groups.name: stress
groups.label: Stress Test
groups.description: k6, 20 users moving money, buying and logging in at once, with double presses; about a minute

groups.name: spike
groups.label: Spike Test
groups.description: k6, 2 users, then 30 more for 20 s, then 2 again, to see it recover; about a minute

groups.name: soak
groups.label: Soak Test
groups.description: k6, 5 users for 10 minutes, the bank's memory watched; about 11 minutes

groups.name: breakpoint
groups.label: Breakpoint Test
groups.description: k6, load rising until the bank breaks, then the money checked; up to about 6 minutes

groups.name: self-healing
groups.label: Self-Healing Test
groups.description: AI agent scenarios: self-healing, diagnosis and policy; several minutes
